evidence.proved: the free plan's programmatic record update is a per-record DynURL HTTP GET; dyndns has no interface vocabulary term, so interface stays unknown and interface_detail names the mechanism
evidence.quote: Dynamic DNS service by ClouDNS provides a unique URL called DynURL with each A (IPv4) and AAAA (IPv6) record.

evidence.proved: a documented REST HTTP API manages all resources including DNS records
evidence.quote: The HTTP API provides the full functionality of the ClouDNS web control panel by simple HTTP calls.

evidence.proved: the DynURL is activated per A or AAAA record in the web panel, then called by an HTTP GET such as https://ipv4.cloudns.net/api/dynamicURL/?q=<token>
evidence.quote: Find the A or AAAA record which you would like to be updated dynamically and click on the arrows on the row for this record. Afterwards, you have to Activate the Dynamic URL in the pop-up.

evidence.proved: the documented REST API is absent on the Free plan, so it is not the free tier's interface
